subject: Pilot budget & procurement path - token spend clarification
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@acmeai.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot budget & procurement path - token spend clarification

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and two asks so we can align the pilot paperwork with your procurement team: 

Recap (30-minute call):
- Pilot scope: 3 feature flows (chat, summarization, reranking), ~90k monthly active users but initial traffic routing expected to be ~200k tokens/day.
- Success criteria: latency under 350ms p50 for chat; cost per 1M tokens <= target band discussed.
- Timeline: pilot start goal = early November; 6-week pilot.

Asks / next steps: 
1) Can you confirm the budget band you have in mind for the pilot (monthly commit range)? We discussed a rough corridor on the call but need a concrete band to price the reserved capacity vs hosted route.
2) What PO threshold does Acme typically require before legal review (e.g., $25k, $50k, $100k)? If the pilot sits below that threshold we can route via standard purchase order; otherwise we’ll include legal in the loop.

Attached: pilot-scope.pdf (high-level scope & usage assumptions)

Below is a quick draft of the unit economics I want to confirm with you before I send a formal quote: 
- Redwood hosted (standard FP32 path): ~$36 / 1M tokens (includes routing, monitoring, and 30-day logging retention)
- Quantized (8-bit) option: ~$19 / 1M tokens (savings from model compression; small quality delta for long-context prompts)
- KV-caching for prefix-heavy flows: estimated 15-25% token reduction in practice (we can instrument during pilot)

If you can reply with: (a) monthly range you expect to commit for the pilot, (b) PO threshold, and (c) whether you want the quantized option included in the initial quote, I’ll circulate a tailored quote and a starter SOW.

Thanks —
Mina

--
Mina Haddad

> 
> Thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and two asks so we can align the pilot paperwork with your procurement team:

Thanks Mina — great walkthrough. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Budget band for pilot: we’re thinking in the $15k–$45k/month range for the first 6–8 weeks (proof-of-concept). That range is intended to cover spikes; if we see strong signal we’ll discuss expansion.
2) PO/legal thresholds: anything above $50k total commitment requires a legal/finance review for Acme. Under $50k we can handle via standard PO with procurement.
3) Quantized option: we’re open to including the 8-bit option in the quote if you can clearly call out expected delta in latency/quality. For customer-facing chat we want minimal regressions.

Attaching the SOW template we typically use for pilots so you can mirror our language: acme-sow-draft.docx

Next steps: please send a quote + recommended PO path (if the pilot baseline is at the top of our band we’ll likely need to involve legal).

—Elena
Elena Park
Director, Product — Acme AI
elena@acmeai.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot budget & procurement path - token spend clarification

Hi Elena — thanks for the quick reply and for the SOW template. Below is the quote framing and the procurement path we recommend given Acme’s $15k–$45k/month band and the $50k legal threshold: 

Quote framing (pilot, 6 weeks):
- Baseline (FP32 hosting): $36 / 1M tokens
- Quantized (8-bit): $19 / 1M tokens
- Expected baseline monthly token consumption (estimate from call): 6M–14M tokens/month (equivalent to the $15k–$45k band at the above rates)

Suggested pilot pricing options: 
A) Hosted, pay-as-you-go + monitoring — no upfront PO required: estimated $15k–$45k/month (variable). Good if you want minimal procurement work but less predictability.
B) Reserved pilot pool (recommended for consistent benchmarking): commit to a 1-month reserved pool within the $20k–$40k range. Reserved pricing provides a 12–18% discount over hosted. If you commit to >= $50k we’ll need legal review per your threshold but we can accelerate with our template clause.

Procurement path recommendation given Acme thresholds: 
- If pilot total <= $50k: use a standard PO. Procurement can accept our quote + SOW.
- If pilot total > $50k: loop in legal early; we suggest redline-lite templates to speed review (I’ll include in the DocuSign packet).

Notes on unit econ and observability: 
- KV-caching projection: 20% token reduction on prefix-heavy flows (we’ll enable instrumentation to measure this during week 1).
- We’ll show both raw token pricing and effective pricing post-cache so you can compare to your internal cost targets.

Attachments: pilot-quote.pdf (includes line items by model path, expected tokens, and two price scenarios: hosted vs reserved)

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) I’ll upload the formal quote to DocuSign with two paths: (a) Hosted/payg and (b) 1-month reserved.
2) Procurement: if you confirm you want the reserved path at the upper band, copy procurement@acmeai.com and we’ll add legal language.
3) Technical kickoff: we can schedule the integration call the week of Oct 18.

If that all looks good I’ll generate the DocuSign packet today for your review.

Thanks —
Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Mina / team —

This looks good. We’ll start with the reserved pilot pool at $30k for the first month (keeps us under the legal review threshold while providing enough runway). Procurement is happy to accept a standard PO for that amount.

Please send the DocuSign quote for $30,000 with the SOW attached and we’ll turn it around within 4 business days. Also include the quantized option as an addendum (we may toggle it during the pilot).

Thanks — Elena
